titulo: The conditional for a future in the past
subtitulo: Dijo que vendría. Sabía que llovería.
regla: The conditional can express the future seen from a past moment, especially in reported speech: Dijo que me llevaría a casa (he said he'd take me home). The action may or may not have happened since.

bloques.texto: When you stand in the **past** and look **forward**, the future becomes the **conditional**:

filas.t: «Te llevo a tu casa», dijo. / «Te llevaré»
Dijo que me llevaría a mi casa.

bloques.texto: It's typical after **dijo que, prometió que, pensé que, sabía que, decidió que, acordamos que**.
**Ir a** works too, in the imperfect: **dijo que iba a llover**. Very common in Mexico.
Tip: future from back then = conditional now.

lista.es: Dijo que me ==llevaría== a mi casa.
lista.en: She said she'd take me home.

lista.es: Mis papás dijeron que me ==comprarían== un carro.
lista.en: My parents said they'd buy me a car.

lista.es: Todos acordamos que no ==tomaríamos== alcohol hasta diciembre.
lista.en: We all agreed we wouldn't drink until December.

lista.es: Carmen decidió que ella ==pagaría== las clases de guitarra de su nieta.
lista.en: Carmen decided she would pay for her granddaughter's guitar lessons.

lista.es: El del clima dijo ayer que hoy ==llovería==.
lista.en: The weatherman said yesterday it would rain today.
He said it was going to rain.

filas.t: Me dijo que vendrá. (a past promise, already over)

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _I knew you would win._
Other option: _He said it was going to rain._
